{
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "packages/features/apps/components/CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx",
      "line": 42,
      "severity": "high",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Deleting cache does not refresh connected calendars",
      "body": "The deleteCache mutation only shows a toast and calls onSuccess; it never invalidates viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars. After a successful deletion the tRPC cache still contains the old cacheUpdatedAt, so the dropdown continues to display the stale timestamp and may still show Delete cached data until a manual refetch. Invalidate the connectedCalendars query, preferably in onSuccess or onSettled."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/features/calendar-cache/calendar-cache.repository.ts",
      "line": 176,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Cache status includes expired cache rows",
      "body": "getCacheStatusByCredentialIds groups CalendarCache rows without an expiresAt filter, while getCachedAvailability only serves rows where expiresAt >= now. Expired cache rows therefore still produce a cacheUpdatedAt value, causing the UI to report an active cache status and last-updated time for data that will not be used. Add expiresAt: { gte: new Date() } to the where clause."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts",
      "line": 1024,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Empty updateMany may not bump SelectedCalendar.updatedAt",
      "body": "fetchAvailabilityAndSetCache calls SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId(this.credential.id, {}) to touch SelectedCalendar.updatedAt. An empty Prisma updateMany payload is fragile: depending on Prisma behavior it may fail validation or not update the timestamp, defeating the stated intent and potentially causing webhook/cron errors. Pass an explicit updatedAt value, for example { updatedAt: new Date() }, and type the repository method with SelectedCalendarUpdateManyMutationInput."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/calendars/deleteCache.handler.ts",
      "line": 17,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "security",
      "title": "Cache deletion authorization only handles directly owned credentials",
      "body": "deleteCacheHandler authorizes only credentials where userId equals the requesting user. Connected calendars can include delegated credentials, as shown by the UI passing delegationCredentialId, and those may not be directly owned by the user. If such a credential has cache entries, the UI can show Delete cached data but the mutation will fail. Use the same access logic as credential deletion or explicitly authorize delegated/team credentials, and return a TRPC FORBIDDEN/NOT_FOUND error rather than a generic Error."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/calendars/_router.tsx",
      "line": 29,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "api",
      "title": "credentialId input should be an integer",
      "body": "The input schema uses z.number(), which accepts floating-point values, but credential IDs are integer primary keys. Use z.number().int(), and optionally positive, so malformed input is rejected before reaching Prisma."
    },
    {
      "file": "packages/features/apps/components/CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx",
      "line": 89,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Cache timestamp is always formatted with en-US",
      "body": "The cache timestamp is formatted with Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US') even though the component uses useLocale. Non-English users will see a US locale format. Use the active locale when creating the formatter."
    },
    {
      "file": "apps/web/package.json",
      "line": 11,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "dev:cron depends on undeclared tsx runtime",
      "body": "dev:cron now runs npx tsx cron-tester.ts, but tsx is not declared as a devDependency. This makes the script depend on npx downloading tsx at runtime, which is non-reproducible and can fail offline or in CI. Add tsx to devDependencies or keep using the already declared ts-node."
    },
    {
      "file": "scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh",
      "line": 68,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Webhook test script is not portable and uses fragile env path",
      "body": "The helper script uses BSD/macOS-specific sed -i '' and assumes ENV_FILE='../.env' relative to the current working directory. On Linux the sed command fails, and when run from the repository root the env path points outside the repo. Use a repo-root-relative .env path and a portable sed invocation."
    }
  ]
}

findings.title: Deleting cache does not refresh connected calendars
findings.body: The deleteCache mutation only shows a toast and calls onSuccess; it never invalidates viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars. After a successful deletion the tRPC cache still contains the old cacheUpdatedAt, so the dropdown continues to display the stale timestamp and may still show Delete cached data until a manual refetch. Invalidate the connectedCalendars query, preferably in onSuccess or onSettled.

findings.title: Cache status includes expired cache rows
findings.body: getCacheStatusByCredentialIds groups CalendarCache rows without an expiresAt filter, while getCachedAvailability only serves rows where expiresAt >= now. Expired cache rows therefore still produce a cacheUpdatedAt value, causing the UI to report an active cache status and last-updated time for data that will not be used. Add expiresAt: { gte: new Date() } to the where clause.

findings.title: Empty updateMany may not bump SelectedCalendar.updatedAt
findings.body: fetchAvailabilityAndSetCache calls SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId(this.credential.id, {}) to touch SelectedCalendar.updatedAt. An empty Prisma updateMany payload is fragile: depending on Prisma behavior it may fail validation or not update the timestamp, defeating the stated intent and potentially causing webhook/cron errors. Pass an explicit updatedAt value, for example { updatedAt: new Date() }, and type the repository method with SelectedCalendarUpdateManyMutationInput.

findings.title: Cache deletion authorization only handles directly owned credentials
findings.body: deleteCacheHandler authorizes only credentials where userId equals the requesting user. Connected calendars can include delegated credentials, as shown by the UI passing delegationCredentialId, and those may not be directly owned by the user. If such a credential has cache entries, the UI can show Delete cached data but the mutation will fail. Use the same access logic as credential deletion or explicitly authorize delegated/team credentials, and return a TRPC FORBIDDEN/NOT_FOUND error rather than a generic Error.

findings.body: The input schema uses z.number(), which accepts floating-point values, but credential IDs are integer primary keys. Use z.number().int(), and optionally positive, so malformed input is rejected before reaching Prisma.

findings.title: Cache timestamp is always formatted with en-US
findings.body: The cache timestamp is formatted with Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US') even though the component uses useLocale. Non-English users will see a US locale format. Use the active locale when creating the formatter.

findings.title: dev:cron depends on undeclared tsx runtime
findings.body: dev:cron now runs npx tsx cron-tester.ts, but tsx is not declared as a devDependency. This makes the script depend on npx downloading tsx at runtime, which is non-reproducible and can fail offline or in CI. Add tsx to devDependencies or keep using the already declared ts-node.
